content:
[policy]
version = "2"
contract_role = "enforced_direction_matrix"
package_boundaries = "../packages/boundaries.toml"
internal_prefix = "polisyos"
src_root = "../../src"

[roots]
# data_forge is the planned build-time layer. calibration is the shared
# diagnostics/recalibration root.
known = [
  "common",
  "schemas",
  "ir",
  "obligation_rules",
  "legal_requirement",
  "core",
  "fabric",
  "foundry",
  "calibration",
  "ddm",
  "data_forge",
  "data_requirement",
  "corpus",
  "policy_grammar",
  "method_requirement",
  "participation_requirement",
  "scientist",
  "runtime",
  "obligation_graph",
  "scholar_requirement",
  "evidence",
  "pdc",
  "scholar",
  "lex",
  "berl",
]

[[package_cycle_baseline]]
id = "package-cycle-2026-05-boundary-repair-baseline"
packages = [
  "polisyos.calibration",
  "polisyos.core",
  "polisyos.data_forge",
  "polisyos.data_requirement",
  "polisyos.fabric",
  "polisyos.fabric.io",
  "polisyos.foundry",
  "polisyos.ir",
  "polisyos.lex",
  "polisyos.obligation_rules",
  "polisyos.pdc",
  "polisyos.policy_grammar",
  "polisyos.runtime",
  "polisyos.scholar",
  "polisyos.scientist",
  "polisyos.scientist.agent",
]
reason = "Existing package-level SCC after neutral-contract extraction; package import gate still fails on new module-level cycles via architecture/imports/lazy.toml."

[internal.allow]
common = ["common"]
schemas = ["schemas", "common"]
ir = ["ir", "schemas", "data_forge", "common"]
obligation_rules = ["obligation_rules", "ir", "core", "common"]
legal_requirement = ["legal_requirement", "core", "ir", "common"]
core = ["core", "ir", "common"]
fabric = ["fabric", "data_requirement", "data_forge", "core", "ir", "common"]
foundry = [
  "foundry",
  "method_requirement",
  "calibration",
  "data_forge",
  "fabric",
  "core",
  "ir",
  "common",
]
calibration = ["calibration", "core", "ir", "common"]
ddm = ["ddm", "core", "ir", "common"]
data_forge = ["data_forge", "fabric", "core", "ir", "common"]
policy_grammar = ["policy_grammar", "scientist", "core", "ir", "common"]
method_requirement = ["method_requirement", "core", "ir", "common"]
participation_requirement = ["participation_requirement", "core", "ir", "common"]
evidence = ["evidence", "core", "ir", "common"]
scientist = [
  "scientist",
  "evidence",
  "obligation_graph",
  "ddm",
  "calibration",
  "berl",
  "participation_requirement",
  "lex",
  "scholar",
  "foundry",
  "method_requirement",
  "fabric",
  "data_forge",
  "pdc",
  "core",
  "ir",
  "common",
]
data_requirement = ["data_requirement", "obligation_graph", "obligation_rules", "policy_grammar", "scientist", "core", "ir", "common"]
corpus = ["corpus", "common"]
runtime = ["runtime", "pdc", "evidence", "scholar_requirement", "scholar", "berl", "scientist", "lex", "data_requirement", "data_forge", "foundry", "method_requirement", "participation_requirement", "fabric", "core", "ir", "common"]
obligation_graph = ["obligation_graph", "core", "ir", "common"]
scholar_requirement = ["scholar_requirement", "core", "common"]
pdc = ["pdc", "core", "ir", "common"]
scholar = ["scholar", "scholar_requirement", "fabric", "ir", "core", "common"]
lex = ["lex", "legal_requirement", "data_forge", "fabric", "ir", "core", "common"]
berl = ["berl", "core", "ir", "common"]

[external.allow.ir]
# Top-level external modules allowed in IR (stdlib is always allowed).
modules = ["pydantic", "typing_extensions", "yaml", "numpy", "pandas", "rustworkx", "networkx", "kuzu"]
